verified_shape.method: counted from the shipped tree at the pinned revision; no card value trusted

claim_337_rounds.claimed: 337 rounds across 12 scenarios (README shields.io badges, and a README table splitting them 95 multi_choice / 242 exec_check)
claim_337_rounds.measured: 1891 rounds across 65 scenarios, split 1543 multi_choice / 348 exec_check
claim_337_rounds.note: the shipped data is LARGER than advertised, not smaller -- the README describes a superseded release. No prefix of the scenario list sums to 337 (12 scenarios = 322, 13 = 352), and the 95/242 split does not match any measured partition. The count that governs is 1891. Every count in the README is stale; every count here was recounted.

verified_shape.scenario_id_anomaly: 64 scenario directories carry id `hil_<letter><digit>`; the directory `eval/hil_c5` ships id `trace_c5`, and `hil_c5` therefore never appears as an id. One scenario is inconsistently named.

executable_checkers.verdict: NOT withheld -- they ship, and they resolve
executable_checkers.schema_inconsistency: the command lives at `exec_check.command` on 64 rounds and at `eval.command` on 284; a consumer reading only one key silently drops 82% of them
executable_checkers.checker_form: shell commands (`test -f`/`grep -q` against ${workspace}) plus 207 python `check_*.py` scripts invoked as ${eval_dir}/${agent_id}/scripts/*.py

preference_construct.design_quote: docs/data-spec/design-plan.md: preferences are injected early via feedback/questions and silently examined later ('前期通过 feedback/问题注入偏好规则，后期静默考察是否遵守')
preference_construct.note: the silent-exam construct is real but thin: 32 of 1891 rounds carry a `pref` checker.

label_provenance.verdict: MODEL-GENERATED. The corrections, preferences and session dialogue are LLM-synthesised by the benchmark's own construction pipeline -- not human corrections captured from real users.
label_provenance.evidence: The project ships its own data-fabrication guidebooks under docs/data-spec/ (`augmentation-guide.md`, `difficulty-upgrade-guide.md`, `data-synthesis-pitfalls.md`). The pitfalls doc states plainly that hil_s1 was 'the first scenario whose dialogue content was batch-generated by a subagent' ('第一个由 subagent 批量生成对话内容的场景') and documents the format bugs that generation produced.
label_provenance.honesty: not misrepresented -- the repo never claims human authorship; the human-authored reading was ours, and it is wrong.

verdict.decision: PINNED AND PROVEN RUNNABLE, but NOT adopted as the preference/user-learning lane's calibration instrument
verdict.reason_1: Its corrections are model-generated (see label_provenance). The gap this pass exists to close is the absence of an external instrument whose labels are NOT LLM-mined; ClawArena does not close it. MemoryCode does, because its graders are hand-written regexes and it never claims to be anything but synthetic.
verdict.reason_2: Its native scoring is unreachable at $0. `exec_check` requires a live coding agent writing files into a workspace; `multi_choice` requires a reader to emit \bbox{} selections. There is no retrieval-only path to a ClawArena score.
verdict.reason_3: It ships no retrieval ground truth, so the adapter's gold is DERIVED BY US and covers only 385 of 1801 rounds (21%).
verdict.what_it_is_good_for: a legitimate agentic-execution benchmark with intact, resolving checkers -- if we ever fund an end-to-end agent lane, this is a real instrument. It is not a memory-retrieval instrument.

adapter.mode: retrieval-only, $0, no reader and no judge
adapter.unit: one workspace file (documents + multi-channel message_logs) of the claude-code arm, ingested as a MemPhant episode (source_kind=resource)
adapter.probe: a round whose own question/feedback/eval prose names a workspace file that exists
adapter.gold_rule: DERIVED BY US, not shipped: gold = the named workspace files. Coverage-biased; see verdict reason_3.

power.n_note: 385 DERIVED probes over 59 scenarios. This is not 1891, and it does not measure what ClawArena measures.

resolvable_effect_size.paired_mcnemar_alpha_0.05_power_0.80: a 5.1pp absolute shift in hit@k (discordant-pair basis, ~30% discordance)
resolvable_effect_size.unpaired_two_proportion_alpha_0.05_power: a ~10.0pp absolute difference between two independent arms at p~0.5
resolvable_effect_size.clustering_caveat: probes cluster in 59 scenarios (mean 6.5/scenario); cluster-bootstrap over scenarios, roughly doubling the resolvable effect.
resolvable_effect_size.validity_caveat: power is not validity. A well-powered measurement of a gold we invented is still a measurement of a gold we invented.

native_run_ceiling.status: NOT RUN, derived ceiling only -- exceeds the $0 constraint, so this pass stopped here as instructed
native_run_ceiling.note: a native run needs a full coding agent (Claude Code / OpenClaw) driving 65 scenarios through 1891 rounds with dynamic update injection, i.e. 1891 agent turns over a 183MB workspace corpus, plus per-round shell verification. That is an agent-hours cost, not a token cost, and it cannot be derived from bytes. No price is asserted here.
